title: Google plans to exempt sanctioned nations from Android developer verification
summary: Developer verification will soon block the installation of apps from unverified developers on any Android device running Google services, which is functionally all Android phones outside Russia and China. Devices in sanctioned countries will be excluded from Android developer verification checks.
